items.title: Wall Street expected to see bonus increases amid major dealmaking
items.summary: Amid major dealmaking and market moves, Wall Street firms — namely Big Banks — could see a major increase in employee bonuses, according to Johnson Associates. Yahoo Finance Senior Banking Reporter David Hollerith reports more on this story.

items.title: Bitcoin Is Down 44%, and BlackRock Just Launched a Fund That Pays You to Wait
items.summary: Bitcoin has spent a year punishing patient holders with nothing but losses and silence. BlackRock just launched a fund that flips that equation, and the structure of the trade reveals something most IBIT investors have not yet considered.
